about_the_game:
Lore

You were working in a weapons factory until the zombie apocalypse arrived without warning. You realized you were alone in the factory. You knew the only way to survive was to create the weapons and ammunition yourself to stop the oncoming waves of zombies.

Description

You have to manage your resources well, how you spend them, and which weapons you create to survive. During the time between zombie waves, be quick to increase your chances of survival and not let the zombies devour you.

Objective

You have to survive as many zombie waves as possible. Each zombie killed increases your resources, which you can use to craft whatever you need.

Features

  • Genre: Incremental autobattle.

  • Theme: Modern Zombie Apocalypse. Environments and characters designed as a stylized blend of pixel art and simple colors.

  • View: Top-down / 2D

  • Infinite Management: Upgrade your factory and consume resources to maintain production.

  • Infinite Survival: Use what was produced, you will see all combat personnel face relentless waves of zombies to defend the factory.

  • Shop and resources: Gather resources from zombies to invest in more weapons, ammunition, and upgrades. All investments will be lost once all defenders are defeated.

  • Roguelike Progression: Each playthrough will earn you currency that you can use to purchase permanent upgrades in the main menu.

  • Difficulty Rewards: Increasing zombie abilities will grant more resources when killed, also unlock new weapons and ammunition.

  • Single Player Focus: Designed for a survival and management challenge.
